chunks: My father (rah) said: It was narrated to me by Ali ibn al-Husayn al-Kufi from his father from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira from al-Sakuni from Ja'far ibn Muhammad from his forefathers (peace be upon them) who said:

Indeed, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, when He intends to afflict the people of the earth with punishment, says: 'If it were not for those who love one another for My sake, and who build My mosques, and who seek forgiveness in the early hours of dawn, if it were not for them, I would surely have sent down My punishment upon them.'

key_terms.یَتَحَابُّونَ فِیَّ: Loving one another for the sake of God

ai.seo_question: Why does Allah delay punishing the people of the earth?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq highlights the intercessory role of the 'mutahabbun fi Allah' (those who love for Allah's sake) as a spiritual shield preventing global calamity. It specifically links the communal act of mosque construction and the individual discipline of pre-dawn repentance (istighfar bil-asihar) to the preservation of the earth, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the merit of the Ahl al-Bayt's followers in sustaining divine mercy.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. My father (rah) said: it was narrated to me by Ali b. al-Hussain al-Kufi from his father from Abdillah b. al-Mughira from al-Sakuni from Ja’far b. Muhammad from his forefathers (a.s.) who said: “
But for those who love each other, build mosques and repent at dawn, I would surely have chastised the people of the earth.”
